title: Senior Data Scientist (Measurement) 5–7 Years
description:
JOB TITLE: Senior Data Scientist – Measurement  
EXPERIENCE: 5–7 Years

DOMAIN: Data Science (Measurement)

JOB SUMMARY

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist specializing in measurement science, experimentation, statistical inference, and causal modeling. The ideal candidate will have strong experience designing and analyzing experiments, measuring the impact of business interventions, and applying causal inference techniques to support evidence-based decisions.

The candidate will lead measurement initiatives involving A/B testing, statistical power analysis, experimental design, quasi-experimental methods, Difference-in-Differences (DiD), Propensity Score Matching (PSM), and causal modeling.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

A. EXPERIMENTATION AND A/B TESTING

1. Design, implement, and analyze A/B tests and controlled experiments.

2. Define hypotheses, primary and secondary metrics, guardrail metrics, treatment groups, and control groups.

3. Perform sample size calculations, statistical power analysis, minimum detectable effect (MDE) estimation, and experiment duration planning.

4. Apply appropriate statistical tests and confidence intervals to estimate treatment effects.

5. Identify experimentation issues such as sample ratio mismatch, selection bias, contamination, novelty effects, and repeated testing.

6. Establish best practices for experimentation design, analysis, and reporting.

B. QUASI-EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN AND CAUSAL INFERENCE

1. Apply quasi-experimental methods when randomized controlled experiments are not feasible.

2. Design and implement Difference-in-Differences (DiD) analyses to estimate intervention effects over time.

3. Use Propensity Score Matching (PSM), weighting, and related approaches to improve comparability between treatment and control groups.

4. Evaluate methodological assumptions, including parallel trends, overlap, confounding, and treatment selection.

5. Apply regression-based causal models, fixed-effects models, and appropriate econometric techniques.

6. Conduct robustness checks, sensitivity analyses, placebo tests, and alternative model specifications.

7. Clearly communicate causal assumptions, limitations, and uncertainty.

C. MEASUREMENT STRATEGY AND BUSINESS IMPACT

1. Develop measurement frameworks to quantify the incremental impact of business initiatives.

2. Translate business objectives into measurable outcomes and appropriate analytical designs.

3. Evaluate measurement methodologies based on business questions, available data, and operational constraints.

4. Identify confounding factors, selection effects, and sources of measurement bias.

5. Develop reusable analytical frameworks, standardized templates, and measurement documentation.

6. Present findings and strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders.

7. Distinguish causal conclusions from correlations and associations.

D. COLLABORATION AND TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP

1. Partner with product, marketing, business, engineering, and analytics teams to define measurement requirements.

2. Review experimental designs, analytical methodologies, model assumptions, and statistical interpretations.

3. Mentor junior data scientists and promote best practices in experimentation and causal inference.

4. Support scalable measurement pipelines and automated reporting processes.

5. Communicate complex statistical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

1. 5–7 years of relevant experience in data science, experimentation, measurement science, econometrics, quantitative research, or causal inference.

2. Master's degree or equivalent quantitative background in Statistics, Economics, Econometrics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related discipline. A PhD is an advantage.

3. Strong foundation in statistical inference, probability theory, regression analysis, hypothesis testing, and experimental design.

4. Hands-on experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and controlled experiments.

5. Practical experience with statistical power analysis, confidence intervals, sample size estimation, and MDE calculations.

6. Strong knowledge of quasi-experimental methods, particularly Difference-in-Differences (DiD) and Propensity Score Matching (PSM).

7. Understanding of causal inference, treatment effects, confounding, selection bias, and identification assumptions.

8. Proficiency in Python or R and strong SQL skills.

9. Experience with statistical libraries such as statsmodels, SciPy, scikit-learn, or equivalent R packages.

10. Ability to select appropriate statistical methods based on business questions and data constraints.

11. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

1. Experience with inverse probability weighting, doubly robust estimation, instrumental variables, regression discontinuity, or synthetic control methods.

2. Experience with longitudinal, panel, customer-level, marketing, product, or operational datasets.

3. Familiarity with heterogeneous treatment effects and uplift modeling.

4. Experience with marketing effectiveness, incrementality testing, attribution, or product experimentation.

5. Knowledge of Bayesian experimentation or sequential testing methods.

6. Experience developing reusable measurement frameworks and automated experiment reporting.

7. Experience mentoring junior analysts or reviewing complex analytical projects.

EXPECTED OUTCOMES

1. Deliver statistically sound experiments and measurement methodologies.

2. Produce credible estimates of incremental business impact.

3. Develop robust causal analyses with clearly documented assumptions and limitations.

4. Improve experimentation practices, measurement consistency, and decision quality.

5. Deliver actionable business recommendations supported by statistical evidence.

title: Data Scientist 3–5 Years
description:
JOB TITLE: Data Scientist (Associate)

EXPERIENCE: 3–5 Years

DOMAIN: Data Science

JOB SUMMARY

We are looking for a Data Scientist (Associate) with experience in statistical analysis, predictive modeling, machine learning, and data-driven problem-solving. The candidate will work with structured and unstructured datasets to identify patterns, develop analytical models, generate business insights, and support evidence-based decision-making.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Collect, clean, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources.

2. Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, anomalies, and business opportunities.

3. Develop, validate, and maintain statistical and machine learning models for prediction, classification, segmentation, and forecasting.

4. Apply statistical techniques such as hypothesis testing, regression analysis, correlation analysis, and probability modeling.

5. Perform feature engineering and feature selection to improve model performance.

6. Evaluate models using appropriate performance metrics, validation strategies, and cross-validation techniques.

7. Translate business problems into analytical approaches and measurable objectives.

8. Develop visualizations, dashboards, and reports to communicate insights.

9. Collaborate with data engineers, business analysts, product managers, and other stakeholders.

10. Document analytical methodologies, assumptions, limitations, and results.

11. Support model deployment, monitoring, and periodic performance evaluation.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

1. 3–5 years of relevant experience in data science, analytics, statistical modeling, or machine learning.

2. Bachelor's or master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.

3. Strong programming skills in Python or R.

4. Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.

5. Strong foundation in statistics, probability, hypothesis testing, and regression.

6. Hands-on experience with pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, SciPy, or equivalent libraries.

7. Experience developing and evaluating supervised and unsupervised machine learning models.

8. Familiarity with visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib, or Seaborn.

9. Understanding of data preprocessing, feature engineering, model validation, and overfitting prevention.

10. Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

1. Experience with time-series analysis, forecasting, customer segmentation, classification, or propensity modeling.

2. Familiarity with cloud-based analytics and machine learning platforms.

3. Experience working with large datasets and data processing frameworks.

4. Understanding of model deployment, monitoring, and reproducible analytical workflows.

5. Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams on business analytics projects.

EXPECTED OUTCOMES

1. Develop reliable statistical and machine learning models.

2. Generate actionable insights and data-driven recommendations.

3. Establish reproducible analytical workflows and well-documented methodologies.

4. Support business decision-making through predictive modeling and exploratory analysis.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Description

**The opportunity**

ICF supports governments and organisations on challenges in areas such as energy, the environment, health and public policy. Our data science team works with subject matter experts to turn evidence and data into practical solutions for clients in the UK and EU.

You will be the first data scientist in our India team. At first, you will meet specialist teams, identify valuable use cases and build focused proofs of concept that demonstrate what data science and AI can do. As these relationships mature, you will help develop our ability to deliver data science and AI solutions across client projects, working with the wider data science team from discovery through implementation. Knowledge of energy would help, initiative, technical breadth and the ability to earn trust across disciplines are central to the role.

**What you will do**

* Meet colleagues across practice areas to understand their work, identify specific use cases and agree what a useful result would look like.
* Initially, scope and demonstrate focused proofs of concept, choosing suitable methods from statistical analysis and forecasting to machine learning and language models.
* Explain methods, limitations and potential value clearly to specialists and nontechnical colleagues. Use their feedback to improve the solution and build confidence in the team’s services.
* Assess data quality, feasibility, privacy and delivery needs, and define the evidence needed to take a prototype further.
* As demand grows, design and deliver data science and AI solutions across projects with the wider team, from modelling and evaluation to integration, documentation and adoption. Contribute to proposals and client presentations.
* Establish reusable ways of working and help turn early demonstrations into a sustainable pipeline of well-defined client work.

**What you will bring**

* Hands-on experience in Python for analysis and modelling, including common data and machine learning libraries, ability to use SQL to extract, join and check data.
* Sound grounding in statistics and machine learning, including regression or classification, forecasting, validation, baseline comparisons and appropriate performance measures.
* Practical familiarity with using large language models in analysis or prototyping, including prompting, checking outputs against evidence and recognising privacy, accuracy and reliability risks.
* Experience preparing imperfect data, building reproducible analyses and writing maintainable code with version control and testing.
* Ability to take an ambiguous question from discovery to a working demonstration, explain assumptions and uncertainty, and judge whether a solution is worth developing for operational use.
* Confidence working independently and engaging stakeholders across teams, clear written and spoken English for technical and nontechnical audiences.
* A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field.

**Useful additional experience**

* Experience in energy, utilities, climate or environmental policy, particularly applied analysis with domain experts.
* Experience in consulting, public policy research or client-facing delivery, familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, data pipelines or deployment.
* Experience building AI agents or applications that connect language models to data and tools, such as retrieval-based systems. We can train someone with strong core skills.

**How we work**

As the first data scientist in our India team, you will have the opportunity to shape how our established data science and AI services grow there. You will work alongside colleagues with a wide range of technical and subject expertise, tackle varied client challenges, and see promising ideas develop into project work. We will support your career development with ongoing training and opportunities to deepen both your technical and consulting skills.

**Bot and Third-Party Applications**

Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance.

**Working at ICF**

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

**Candidate AI Usage Policy**

At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair and equitable interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process.

However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodations that involve the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at candidateaccommodation@icf.com. We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.

  
New Delhi, India (II77)

Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

Who you will work with

* BCN Labs work directly with other CoEs and Practices within Bain as part of the Expert Client Delivery system and interface with global teams across.
* BCN Labs is first and foremost business thought partner working on intelligent ways of using analytical techniques and algorithms across the spectrum of disciplines that can enable building world-class solutions.
* Our goal is to build a disruptive high-impact business-enabled end-to-end analytical solutions delivery system across all verticals of Bain.

About you

* 6+ years of relevant professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, or AI (5+ years with a relevant Master’s degree), including experience leading technical workstreams and providing technical direction and mentorship to junior Data Scientists.

What you’ll do

* Mentorship & Team Leadership: Guide and mentor junior Data Scientists through technical direction, modelling and code reviews, and structured problem solving, helping them build stronger technical capabilities and operate independently.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with business stakeholders, domain experts, and engineers to understand requirements, communicate analytical findings and technical trade-offs, and develop solutions that address real business needs.

What makes us a great place to work

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years.
